relations.rationale: Both claims describe team compositions but neither entails the other since teams could still overlap or differ independently.

Arriving last doesn't inherently relate to the state of his boots being muddy.

Otto jogging to catch up is unrelated to Pia's comment about lighting for photography.
Otto catching up with the group is unrelated to everyone sharing water.

Otto's muddy boots have no bearing on Ivo and Dara being on different teams.
